The full scope includes all files in the Wikimedia Commons category "Scientific instruments" where the filename contains "Skoklosters slott" and the ending collection number is between 92839 and 92916 (inclusive). How many "component groups" are visible in each main image, and are the groups completely separated by visible background? Provide a complete itemized table containing "Filename, Collection Number, Number of Visible Component Groups, Existence of Completely Separated Components". Which files belong to the "Needs Component Close-up" and "No Component Close-up Needed" groups respectively, and what are the counts for each?

Each continuous image area formed by the artifact itself and its accompanying accessories in the main image counts as one "component group". Parts that touch each other or are connected by the artifact's own cords/straps still count as one group; paper collection labels, number plates, and their attaching strings do not count and cannot be used to connect two groups. Classify as "Needs Component Close-up" if there are at least two component groups in the main image and the groups are completely separated by visible background; otherwise, classify as "No Component Close-up Needed". Each member of the full set must appear only once.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of "Filename—Collection Number—Number of Visible Component Groups—Existence of Completely Separated Components—Grouping", followed by a Q&A section listing the files and counts for each of the two groups separately.
